from collections import Counter
import json
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('analysis/probe-attempt-02')
rows=[json.loads(r) for r in base.with_suffix('.stdout.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
runs=Counter(r['Test'] for r in rows if r['Action']=='run' and 'Test' in r)
passes=Counter(r['Test'] for r in rows if r['Action']=='pass' and 'Test' in r)
assert runs and runs==passes and set(runs.values())=={3}
assert any(r['Action']=='pass' and 'Test' not in r for r in rows)
print('Named cases:',len(runs),'top-level:',sum('/' not in t for t in runs),'run/pass events:',sum(runs.values()))
print('Additional passing cases:',*[t for t in runs if t.startswith(('TestIdentityCallerDeparture','TestIdentityMatchingAfterMismatch'))],sep='\n')
print('Fail/skip records:',sum(r['Action'] in ('fail','skip') for r in rows))
print('Stderr bytes:',base.with_suffix('.stderr.log').stat().st_size)
